conditions.notes: OBS-0006's method was delivered-vs-canonical comparison. OBS-0013 records an onboarding path where that method has no left-hand side in the field. If session-only invitations become normal, the OBS-0006 class of observation becomes rarer not because channels got cleaner, but because the measurement baseline stopped being filed.
